locator: Results 'RNA splicing analysis reclassifies 54% of VUS' paragraph 1
printed_value: In most cases (87%, n = 176/202) variants were identified as potentially spliceogenic by a laboratory specialist using Alamut Visual Plus (>10% change in 2 of 4 predictions) before RNA analysis was requested.

locator: Discussion paragraph 5
printed_value: LeafCutterMD is not designed to identify intron retention events; one aberrant transcript was an intron retention in five of the 16 events (cases 28, 37, 61, 63 and 69).

locator: Results 'Aberrant Splicing Detection' paragraph 3; Discussion paragraphs 5 and 10
printed_value: Results: FRASER |dPSI| > 0.1 identified 81.26% (13/16) of events, FRASER2 68.7% (11/16) and LeafCutterMD 25%. Discussion: FRASER2 detects 66.6% of pathogenic events.

locator: Results 'Detection of aberrant splicing' paragraph 3
printed_value: saseR-bins, saseR-ASpli, LeafcutterMD and SPOT could not be benchmarked on the Kremer dataset, as only junction read-counts are publicly available.
